# File Structure Overview

## Root Level

| File/Folder | Purpose | Editable? | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-----------|-------|
| `index.html` | Main HTML shell + markup | ✅ Yes | Never bundle; only CSS + JS refs |
| `styles/app.css` | CSS entry barrel | ❌ No (see `styles/`) | Don't edit directly |
| `scripts/app.js` | JS entry barrel | ❌ NO | Generated by `build-runtime.mjs`; NEVER hand-edit |
| `assets/` | Images, icons | ✅ Yes | WebP format only; optimize via `npm run optimize:images` |
| `tests/` | E2E + unit tests | ✅ Yes | Playwright (e2e) + Node (unit) |
| `docs/` | Documentation (architecture, API, etc.) | ✅ Yes | Mirrors folder structure |
| `dist/` | Production build output | ❌ NO | Generated by `build:dist`; gitignored |
| `.tsbuild/` | TypeScript compilation temp | ❌ NO | Generated by `tsc`; do not touch |
| `.github/` | CI/CD workflows, skills | ✅ Yes | GitHub Actions, Speckit skills |
| `package.json` | NPM config | ✅ Yes | Bump versions, add scripts carefully |

---

## `scripts/` (TypeScript Modules)

All `.ts` files compile to `.js` in `.tsbuild/`, then `build-runtime.mjs` concatenates in strict order.

### Subcategories

| Folder | Files | Responsibility | Import Rule |
|--------|-------|-----------------|------------|
| `scripts/config/` | `app-config.ts` | Constants, game balance | Import only by `app-main.ts` |
| | `types.ts` | Runtime-evaluated const arrays (`CLASS_IDS`, `PHASES`, etc.) | **MUST be first in bundle** |
| `scripts/state/` | `app-state.ts` | Global mutable state (hero, enemies, turn) | Import by UI + core |
| | `persistence.ts` | LocalStorage save/load logic | Import by state + UI |
| `scripts/core/` | `geometry.ts` | Board layout, positioning math | Import by UI + audio + combat |
| | `audio.ts` | Sound effects + music | Import by UI + combat + game-flow |
| | `dice.ts` | Dice logic (pure) | Import by combat + game-flow |
| | `combat.ts` | Combat resolution (pure) | Import by game-flow |
| | `game-flow.ts` | Turn/phase state machine | Import by UI + audio + combat |
| `scripts/ui/` | All `*-ui.ts` | DOM manipulation + event listeners | Import state + core; never state mutation |
| | `modal-manager.ts` | Modal lifecycle + transitions | Import by UI layers |
| `scripts/` (root) | `app-core.ts` | Barrel of `state/` + `core/` | **Tests only** (not in bundle) |
| | `app-main.ts` | App entry point | **Last in bundle** |

### When to Rebuild

**After editing any `.ts` file in `scripts/`, run `npm run build:runtime`**, which:
1. Compiles with `tsc` → `.tsbuild/*.js`
2. Strips `import`/`export` statements
3. Concatenates in `sourceFiles` order → `scripts/app.js`

**Exception**: if only editing tests, no rebuild needed (they import directly from `.ts`, not from `app.js`).

---

## `styles/` (CSS Modules)

All `.css` files cascade from `styles/app.css`, organized by concern.

### Barrel Structure

| Folder | Barrel | Files | Purpose |
|--------|--------|-------|---------|
| `styles/global/` | `global/global.css` | `_colors.css`, `_gradients.css`, `_typography.css`, `_motion.css`, `_shadows.css` | Design tokens, theme |
| `styles/base/` | `base/base.css` | `reset.css`, `topbar.css`, `layout.css` | Global resets + layout |
| `styles/board/` | `board/board.css` | `board-frame.css`, `board-slots.css`, `enemy-card.css`, etc. | Game board UI |
| `styles/sidebar/` | `sidebar/sidebar.css` | `sidebar-panel.css`, `dice.css`, `skills.css`, `resources.css`, etc. | Game sidebar UI |
| `styles/modals/` | `modals/modals.css` | `modal-shell.css`, `start-modal.css`, `save-load.css`, etc. | Modals + dialogs |
| `styles/responsive/` | `responsive/responsive.css` | `desktop.css`, `tablet.css`, `mobile.css`, `mobile-small.css`, `misc.css` | Media queries |

### Key Files

- **`styles/app.css`**: Main entry point. Import order must be:
  1. `global/` (tokens first)
  2. `base/` (resets)
  3. `board/`, `sidebar/`, `modals/` (components)
  4. `responsive/` (overrides)

- **`styles/board/board-overrides.css`**: Contains **intentional duplicate selectors** (`.enemy-meta`, `.board-frame`, etc.) that cascade-override earlier rules by spec. Must import **last** in `styles/board/board.css`. See [css-module-architecture](../../css-module-architecture/SKILL.md) for details.

- **`styles/global/_colors.css`**: Single source of truth for all hex/rgb values. Never declare a literal `#fff` or `rgb(...)` outside this file.

## `tests/` (Test Suites)

### E2E Tests (Playwright)

| File | Tests | Scope | When to Use |
|------|-------|-------|-------------|
| `tests/e2e/e2e.spec.js` | 34 tests | Game flow, UI interactions, a11y | Any behavior change |
| `tests/e2e/visual-regression.spec.js` | 8 tests | Layout snapshots (chromium, webkit, mobile) | CSS changes, design updates |

- **Setup**: `playwright.config.js` (3 projects: chromium, webkit, mobile)
- **Server**: `serve-static.mjs` (runs on port 4173 during tests)
- **Run**: `npm run test:chromium` (fast local), `npm run test:e2e` (all projects)

### Unit Tests (Node)

| File | Scope | When to Use |
|------|-------|------------|
| `tests/unit/app-core.test.mjs` | Core logic (combat, dice, geometry) | Logic changes in `scripts/core/` + `scripts/state/` |

- **Run**: `npm run test:unit`
- **Coverage**: `tests/unit/results/results.tap` (TAP format)

---

## `docs/` (Documentation)

Mirrors `scripts/` + `styles/` structure:

| File | Content |
|------|---------|
| `docs/index.md` | Overview + command reference |
| `docs/architecture/scripts.md` | Details on `build-runtime.mjs`, module imports, TS config |
| `docs/architecture/css.md` | CSS barrel pattern, theme, tokens, gotchas |
| `docs/architecture/structure.md` | This file essentially |
| `docs/testing/e2e.md` | Playwright setup, gotchas, snapshot regeneration |
| `docs/testing/unit.md` | Unit test patterns + coverage targets |
| `docs/ci-cd.md` | GitHub Actions workflow |
| `docs/assets.md` | WebP pipeline, rembg script |
| `docs/conventions.md` | Code style, UX, workflow conventions |
| `docs/technical-debt.md` | Known debt (TS 5.x pinned, etc.) |

---

## `assets/` (Images)

| Subfolder | Format | Usage | Notes |
|-----------|--------|-------|-------|
| `assets/icons/` | .webp | UI icons, card symbols | 16-256px |
| `assets/images/` | .webp | Background, cards, board | Optimized via `npm run optimize:images` |

**Rule**: All images must be WebP. PNG/JPG sources fed through `rembg` (removes BG) → WebP → hash in `dist/` on production build.

---

## `.github/` (CI/CD + Skills)

| Folder | Content |
|--------|---------|
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | GitHub Actions: typecheck, lint, test, deploy |
| `.github/skills/speckit-*` | Speckit skills for feature workflow |
| `.github/skills/project-*` | Project-specific skills (this directory) |

Skills referenced by Speckit workflow, not for general development.

---

## Generated / Ignored Folders

| Folder | Source | Gitignored? | When Generated |
|--------|--------|------------|-----------------|
| `.tsbuild/` | `tsc` | ✅ Yes | `npm run build:runtime` |
| `dist/` | `build:dist` | ✅ Yes | `npm run build:dist` |
| `node_modules/` | npm | ✅ Yes | `npm install` |
| `tests/e2e/results/` | Playwright | Partial (HTML) | After test run |
| `tests/unit/results/` | Node test runner | ✅ Yes | After test run |
| `.playwright/` | Playwright | ✅ Yes | Test infrastructure |

**Never commit or edit these folders.**
